objective: Add a source-only, division-free scheduler successor to M1995. Preserve the public interface and M803/fetch/bridge/Acc24/commit/debug transaction semantics while replacing both runtime schedule mappings with generate-time wiring into one common 192-bit ordered row-live bitmap and one common 12-by-16 hierarchical priority encoder.

m2015_static_audit_premise.ruling: M1995 two-axis physical comparison is structurally unfair until runtime quotient/remainder mapping and wide dynamic active-array selection are removed from both axes. This premise is context supplied to M2018; M2018 itself does not rerun synthesis.

additive_architecture.priority_encoder: 12 blocks by 16 rows, local-first then block-first
additive_architecture.row_live_rule: load OR-reduction of the exact 16-bit active row; empty row is never live
additive_architecture.selected_payload: one selected 16-bit active row and one selected 16-bit sign row are latched in ST_FIND

static_test_obligations: module parameters and all public ports are byte-exact to M1995 after the module name
M1995, M1880, and docs/359 identities remain exact
synthesizable source has no runtime division or remainder operator
scheduler has no read from the two-dimensional active/sign storage
both modes statically map all legal G1/G12/G48 rows into one 192-bit bitmap
the common selector is visibly hierarchical 12-by-16
row_live is reset, loaded from exact activity, consumed at select, and cleared at done
the selected active/sign row feeds the existing signed bridge
contract is double sealed and execution remains forbidden
